I couldn't get flange_v1 to SF 2.0 by changing any single parameter. The baseline SF is 0.212 under the default load (8000 N, -Z on `face_mating`). Max stress is 848.5 MPa against a 180 MPa yield, with the peak on `face_mounting`.

I tried each parameter at its most favorable allowed value:

| Parameter | Original | Tried | SF |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thickness_mm` | 2 | 5 (sheet-stock max) | 0.839 |
| `hole_diameter_mm` | 10 | 4 (M4 minimum) | 0.354 |
| `fillet_radius_mm` | 1.5 | 6 | 0.212 (no effect) |

I reverted each change before probing the next, and nothing was saved. I reported the result as `no_fix_possible`. The part is the latest revision (rev 1).

Recording lessons failed to persist because memory is disabled for this run.
